detail: L Catterton India Fund has made an investment in Nandhana Foods Private Limited by way of a subscription to newly issued equity shares and the acquisition of equity shares from existing shareholders. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised L Catterton on this transaction. The Firm advised on all aspects of the transaction, including the legal due diligence and the transaction documents. The transaction team was led by Aditi Manchanda (Partner), Saloni Shroff (Partner), and Sonakshi Arora (Partner), with support from Geetika Myer (Principal Associate), Deepjoyika Dastidar (Principal Associate – Designate), Kaushik Raichura (Senior Associate), Harshvardhan Tripathi (Senior Associate), Associates…
